title: CommonTrace Graph Edge
description: A directed property edge linking two entities in the CommonTrace temporal knowledge graph with bitemporal validity bounds and connection weight.

source.description: Source node ID (origin of the directed relationship).

target.description: Target node ID (destination of the directed relationship).

relation.description: Semantic relationship type connecting source to target.

weight.description: Connection strength and confidence weight, bounded in [0.0, 1.0].

valid_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp from which this edge holds.

invalid_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which a later assertion or a forget closed this edge, or null while it holds.

expired_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp after which this edge lapses, or null for no expiry.

properties.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata and edge attributes.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recording when this edge was created.
